sections.name: XBEAM
sections.view: 中間横桁 S=1:30 elevation (C1~C19部) with plan of the bottom flange; callouts read between G1 and G2 (10500 span)

lessons: Page 41 is drawing J-74 中間横桁 (縮尺 図示, S=1:30 near the top). The number is in the rightmost title block cell, and the 設計名称 reads 新田豊島橋(仮称)実施設計.

On the intermediate cross beam sheet the top flange is the steel deck, so only the web and bottom flange are callouts. Web callouts read N-WEB PL WxTxL (SM490YA): 3 is 1418x9x1010, 4 is 1327x9x2870 and 5 is 1119x9x2680. The cantilever-end webs 1 and 2 are 1074x10x3253 and 1400x10x835.

Bottom flange callouts are in the plan view below the elevation: 5 is 2-FLG PL 290x19x1021, 6 is 2-FLG PL 290x19x2881 (both SM490YB) and 7 is 1-FLG PL 490x19x2680 (SM490YB). The cantilever ends use 2-FLG PL 220x10x3049 and 897, with no material stated, so SM400A applies by the note.

The web plate widths (1418, 1327, 1119) are not the section depth, because the bottom flange follows a curve (30295.3R). Take the depth from the vertical dimensions: 1400 at the girder ends and about 1100 at midspan, so give a range.

The cross beam 配置図 and the 22000 / 10500 dimensions are overall layout values, not a web spacing. The 1600 dimension is the main girder web spacing and 10500 is the G1-G2 span. The cross beam has a single web plane, so web spacing is not applicable.
Table tw/t1/L1 (C1 18/8/1584, C2~C5 23/13/1574, C6,C7 18/8/1584, C8~C12 16/6/1588) gives the main girder web thickness and gap at each cross beam, not the cross beam web. The cross beam web is 9 mm.

The general note says unlabelled material = SM400A, and the H.STIFF PL 120x10 and V.STIFF PL 100x9 pieces carry no material. The scan blurs 6 and 8 (e.g. 1146 vs 1148), so check against neighbouring dimensions.
